title: Google's AI Satellite Just Answered From Space: 3 Things to Know
description:
Google's Project Suncatcher prototype satellite received its first AI prompt in orbit and sent back a reply, which Google calls a "hello world" moment.
3 things to know: it carries four TPU AI chips (launched Oct 1, built with Planet), power allows only one chip at a time for ~20 minutes, and its first answer was a Gemma 4 haiku about space, downlinked over Svalbard, Norway. Two more satellites with laser links are planned for 2027.
